items.definition:
short for cryptocurrency
Many people are investing in crypto these days.

a bright green precious stone
She wore a necklace with a large emerald pendant.

a raised mass of earth or stones
The ancient burial mound was covered in grass.

a parish priest
The parson delivered a sermon on Sunday.

a small hole or mark made by a sharp object
She felt a prick from the rose thorn.

a place, typically a large, deep pit, from which stone or other materials are extracted
The old quarry is now filled with water.

the act of sending someone to another person or place for treatment, help, or advice
The doctor gave me a referral to a specialist.

The fluid that circulates in a plant; a foolish person
Maple sap is collected in spring.

The action or state of setting someone or something apart from others
The civil rights movement fought against racial segregation.

An Arab leader, in particular the chief or head of an Arab tribe, family, or village
The sheikh welcomed the visitors to his palace.

A narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water
The ship sailed through the narrow strait.

The provision of fresh air to a room or building
Good ventilation is essential in a kitchen.

The acquisition or gradual gathering of something
The accumulation of dust made the room look neglected.

An elaborate and formal meal for many people
The king hosted a grand banquet for his guests.

A person who stands at the entrance to a show, carnival, etc., and calls out to passers-by to attract customers
The barker shouted loudly to attract people to the circus tent.

Valuables or money obtained illegally or as plunder
The pirates divided their stolen booty.

the ability of two things to exist or be used together without problems
We checked the compatibility of the new software with our old system.

a vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change
She launched a crusade against plastic pollution.

a high explosive consisting of nitroglycerine mixed with an absorbent material
The engineers used dynamite to clear the rockslide.

the quality of having a modest or low view of one's own importance
Despite his success, he always showed great humility.

The act of charging a public official with misconduct.
The impeachment process began after the allegations surfaced.

A large number of people or things.
A multitude of stars filled the night sky.

A person or thing that inspires an artist.
Her garden was her muse for her paintings.

The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group.
The nucleus is at the center of an atom.

A thorough examination and repair of machinery or a system.
The car needed a complete overhaul.

Devotion to and vigorous support for one's country.
His patriotism was evident in his actions.

The state of being ready or prepared.
The team showed great readiness for the competition.

A similarity or likeness.
There's a strong resemblance between the two sisters.

a talk on a religious or moral subject
The pastor delivered a powerful sermon on forgiveness.

a detailed description of how something should be done, made, etc.
The new product meets all the required specs.

a person who is easily tricked or fooled
Don't be a sucker and fall for that scam.

the state of being superior
He had a sense of intellectual superiority.

a device that sends out radio or television signals
The radio station uses a powerful transmitter.

a period during which a war is being fought
Many changes occur in society during wartime.

a painted cloth hung at the back of a stage
The mountains provided a stunning backdrop for the wedding photos.

a period when all lights are off, usually due to a power failure
The entire city experienced a blackout.

an attempt to deceive someone into believing that one can do something that one cannot
His threat was just a bluff.

a meeting of party members to choose candidates or decide policy
The party members held a caucus to select their presidential nominee.

a journalist who writes a regular column in a newspaper or magazine
She works as a political columnist for a national newspaper.

the ability to do something successfully or efficiently
His competence in the field is undeniable.

an expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of death
We offered our sincere condolences to the family.

a tube or channel for conveying a substance or fluid
The air conditioning system uses large metal ducts.

a symbolic object or design
The dove is an emblem of peace.

a person in charge of a group of workers
The construction foreman supervised the team.

a slowly moving mass or river of ice formed by the accumulation and compaction of snow on mountains or near the poles
The glacier slowly moved down the valley.

a mass arrival or inpouring
There has been a large influx of tourists this summer.

the innermost part of a nut or seed
The kernel of the argument was quite simple.

an immature form of an insect
The caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly.

a picture or pattern produced by arranging together small pieces of stone, tile, or glass
The ancient church had beautiful mosaics on its walls.

a chemical element
Bananas are a good source of potassium.

steroid
The doctor prescribed a steroid cream for the rash.

a strong taste or smell
The lemon had a sharp tang.

telecommunications
The telecom industry is rapidly evolving.

the quality of being toxic
The report highlighted the toxicity of the chemical.

archaeology
She is studying archaeology at university.

a sudden, intensive attack
The police launched a blitz on illegal parking.

blockade
The port was under a naval blockade.

cartridge
I need to replace the ink cartridge in my printer.

cloak; a loose outer garment
The mysterious figure wore a dark cloak.

comprehension; understanding
Reading comprehension is a key skill for students.

a curved shape, tapering to a point at each end
The moon was a thin crescent in the night sky.

a strong underground prison cell
The knight was locked in the castle dungeon.

an annoying inconvenience
Dealing with customer service was a real hassle.

horse rider in races
The jockey wore a colorful silk uniform.
